scientific_integrity: The fixed-image proof, exact rank formula and logarithmic asymptotic are provided in RESULT.md; primary sources and residual originality uncertainty are specified. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is about total weak endomorphism idempotents of labeled complete bipartite graphs, not arbitrary multipartite graphs.
The balanced probability has a logarithmic asymptotic with O(m) remainder, no multiplicative constant.
Finite exhaustive tests corroborate but do not establish the infinite theorem.
Publication priority under other reflexive-homomorphism terminology is not independently certified.
title: Exact rank spectra and asymptotic side rigidity for weak biclique retractions
